title: Dark Glueball Direct Detection
summary: We consider glueball dark matter (DM) in a Yang-Mills dark sector confined at $Λ_D$ scale and coupled to the Standard Model through electrically and dark-color charged vector-like fermion portals, with the mass scale $m_ψ$. In a simple case with two lightest mass-degenerate vector-like fermions with opposite electric charges the effective amplitudes with one $C$-odd glueball (oddball) and odd number of photons vanish, rendering the lightest $C$-odd spin-1 state with mass $m_χ$ a viable DM candidate provided that $m_ψ\gtrsim 5.5 Λ_D$.
